name: RSI(2) Mean Reversion (Connors)
source: Classic — Larry Connors' RSI(2) mean-reversion system, long-only pullback-in-an-uptrend variant
notes: Hand-authored baseline, not scraped. Buys a short-term oversold dip (2-period RSI) only while price is above the long-term trend filter (200-period SMA); exits once RSI recovers. Long-only by design — RSI(2) is a pullback-in-an-uptrend system, not a symmetric trend-follower.
